pr_title: Close multiples issues on HTTP behavior
pr_body: closes #377 A valid message is now returned if there is no index. closes #372 A stop word addition without schema is now processed. closes #316 The response for API Keys is now more clear. Closes #325 Return formatted section on search only if it's requested. Closes #369 This doesn't unwrap anymore touch #397 closes #402 Check settings, there are all to null Push new settings Check settings, they have the right values Remove settings Check settings, there are all to null
pr_comments:
This message will be used for another PR, we would just like to be able to ignore `null`s in this one.

----

Concerning the warning/error handling when serializing the user data. Things I thought about were:

  - Add a `&mut Vec<String>` [the `Indexer` struct](https://github.com/meilisearch/MeiliSearch/blob/5ad73fe08b443639d5b3019977cbf72b40f96c21/meilisearch-core/src/serde/indexer.rs#L9-L13) and push the error message in it
  - Add another field named `user_document_id` which represent the human readable document id, its type would be a String
  - Retrieved it from [the `extract_document_id` function](https://github.com/meilisearch/MeiliSearch/blob/5ad73fe08b443639d5b3019977cbf72b40f96c21/meilisearch-core/src/serde/extract_document_id.rs#L10-L19) which will return a tuple `(DocumentId, String)`.
  - We need to [keep both the `DocumentId` and the String](https://github.com/meilisearch/MeiliSearch/blob/5ad73fe08b443639d5b3019977cbf72b40f96c21/meilisearch-core/src/serde/extract_document_id.rs#L248-L254) that has been hashed to produce this id. You will have [to change the type to be a tuple](https://github.com/meilisearch/MeiliSearch/blob/5ad73fe08b443639d5b3019977cbf72b40f96c21/meilisearch-core/src/serde/extract_document_id.rs#L212) to do that.

Once the human readable `DocumentId` in the `Indexer` struct ypu will be able to create human readable warning message that refers to the user documents ids.

The stop-words error was raised on stop-words deletion not addition (or both?).
https://github.com/meilisearch/MeiliSearch/pull/400/commits/88b3c051551ad49e3c0ac94ea89dcc27d1d02fb8#diff-56b030e9acd5f91a213486828900546c
That's an awesome PR here! Great job 💯

issue_context.title: [API] Delete index route when Index Not Found
issue_context.body: If I call the route `DELETE /indexes/:uid` and `uid` does not exist, I don't have any error message in the body (unlike all the others indexes routes)
